Centered.prompt: center weighted composition with symmetrical balance, strong subject authority, direct visual emphasis, stable formal framing language

Diagonal Energy.prompt: diagonal compositional flow using tilted lines or posture vectors, dynamic tension, kinetic visual momentum

Foreground Layer.prompt: foreground element layering to add depth and parallax, partial frame overlap, enhanced cinematic dimensionality

Leading Lines.prompt: composition guided by converging leading lines toward subject, depth reinforcement, viewer eye path control, narrative directionality

Negative Space.prompt: expanded negative space around subject for minimalist emphasis, clean readability, strong figure to ground separation

Rule of Thirds.prompt: rule of thirds subject placement with intentional negative space, directional gaze room, visually dynamic but balanced image structure

Symmetrical.prompt: strict symmetrical framing with mirrored architectural or environmental lines, central axis precision, highly ordered visual rhythm

Composition.base_prompt: portrait setup with clear subject readability, realistic scale cues, controlled environment depth, strong photographic craft and intentional framing
